entity_history.title: What happened to it
entity_history.description: Every committed batch that touched one entity, newest first. Each answers as the patch that batch applied — the components it wrote, or `$delete` for the death it was — stamped with who wrote it, when, and through what instrument. The log is written inside the transaction that wrote, so this is blame and diff without a version table; it starts where this graph started journaling.

entity.description: whose past to read — an id, a name, or an eid

limit.description: at most this many batches, counting back from the newest
